topic: Repeat purchases: Rs 800 ad spend, one-time buyer (perfume)
lines: Aath sau rupay ka ad lagaya, aur customer ne sirf ek baar khareeda.
Perfume tees din mein khatam, aur aapko pata hi nahi.
Usne dobara kisi aur se kharid liya.
Naya customer aath sau rupay ka, purane ko ek message, lagbhag muft.
Din satais par A I poochta hai: perfume khatam hone wala hai, repeat?
Ek tap, doosra order, ad ka ek rupay nahi laga.
Yeh reel kisi seller ko bhejein.
